name: Lock AERO permanently, vote every epoch, short the AERO perp on the venue that pays shorts most: collect voter rewards net of the hedge
thesis: Aerodrome pays veAERO voters 100% of the swap fees and all the bribes of the pools they vote for, in real tokens; two non-price motives pay it (protocols buying emissions, traders paying fees) and the scarce input is a multi-year lock. With AERO's price shorted away the residue is a carry. Over 116 hedged epochs (2024-07-18..2026-10-01; 163 epochs of voter data since 2023-08-24) the pre-committed hedge on Binance/Bybit earned +4.10% a year over the 3.80% savings rate on capital out of sample (2025-08-28..2026-10-01, t 1.47, not significant; +0.90% when only major-token rewards are counted): AERO perp funding cost a short 15.5% a year on those venues over the hedged window. Hedged instead on whichever venue paid shorts most over the trailing four epochs (Hyperliquid in 38 of 58 test epochs), the same lock earned +11.32% (t 3.81; +8.12% majors-only; positive in both halves of the test window). The live trade is not a go: the legacy system the history measures ends at the 2026-10-22 merger into Aero (two epochs left), the post-merger sAERO economics are unpublished, and exiting a lock costs 15-21% (median discount of veAERO sales over the last 365 days: 14.9% on Vexy listings, 20.9% into Vexy bids; 28% via iAERO's $45k pool), i.e. 13-19 months of the best-venue excess (break-even discount 13.5% after 12 months, 27.4% after 24).
mechanism: Voter APR (average vote, permanent lock, rewards priced a day after the flip with a 20% haircut on non-major tokens) fell from 39.1% (2024) to 26.8% (2025) and 15.5% (2026, at a $0.44 mean AERO price); at $0.83 the current epoch indicates about 9% before late bribes. Shorts paid on Binance/Bybit because AERO's perp is where emissions farmers and lockers hedge (funding to a short: Binance -14.7%, Bybit -11.1% over each venue's life); Hyperliquid's AERO longs pay the interest leg (+2.0% to shorts since its 2025-11-11 listing, +9.6% over the last 26 epochs), the same venue premium found for HYPE in term_carry. Votes were stale in 2023-24 (an attentive $1M voter earned +15-21pp of APR over the average) but no longer: in the second half of the history only last-hour votes kept a premium (+4.3pp at $1M), a timing game: 10.7% of votes move in the final hour, when only whitelisted veNFTs may vote and everyone else can only reset.
legs: after the merger only: convert or create a permanent sAERO stake (MetaDEX VotingEscrow, permanent mode) and allocate it to the pools with the highest posted revenue per staked AERO, re-allocating no more often than the allocation cooldown allows

short the staked AERO quantity on the venue with the best trailing-four-epoch funding to shorts (Hyperliquid, else Bybit/Binance/OKX), cash margin at 3x; add the rebase (if any survives the merger) to the short weekly
claim fees and incentives weekly and sell them within a day; keep 0.7x notional of liquid reserve for margin calls (AERO doubled between 2026-07 and 2026-10)
kill_criteria: go only after eight post-merger weeks of sAERO data in which staker revenue per staked AERO, plus funding to the short on the hedge venue, beats the savings rate by 5pp on capital (1 + 1/3 per unit of notional)

an exit market for sAERO positions with a median discount below 10% and at least $1M a month of volume (today, legacy veAERO: Vexy listings 14.9% and bids 20.9% over the last 365 days, about $2.3M of locked value a month across all venues; iAERO 0.754 of AERO in a $45k pool)
trailing-four-week funding to an AERO short below -5% a year on every venue with open interest above $20M
Hyperliquid AERO open interest below $20M or its 1%-band bid depth below $100k (the leg the excess rests on)
any change that lets the protocol confiscate, dilute or stop paying revenue to permanent stakes; any perp delisting of AERO on the hedge venue
risks: exit: the lock cannot be undone; the hedge only neutralises price, so every exit pays the lock discount (veAERO sales: median 27.1% over 2,256 valued sales since 2023, 16.8% over the last 365 days, 34.1% for locks worth $100k or more); at the chosen variant's +10.4% a year the break-even discount is 13.5% after 12 months and 27.4% after 24; buying locks at the prevailing discount instead (entry variant) lifts the test-window excess to +13.2-14.1% best venue, +5.3-5.8% main venue, and turns the exit risk into the risk of the discount widening (it narrowed from 38% in 2024 to 16% in 2026)

regime: the merger replaces epochs with continuous allocation and a 47-hour allocation cooldown, ends legacy emissions and voting on 2026-10-22, and its Base contracts are unpublished; none of the measured history is from that system
venue concentration: the excess over the CEX hedge is Hyperliquid's funding premium; HL AERO is capped at 3x leverage, has $36M of open interest and $179k of bids within 1%

selection: the best-venue rule was added after the venue-level funding of the test window had been seen (no carry results had); the clean pre-committed result is +4.10% (t 1.47); the repo's term_carry study had independently documented the Hyperliquid funding premium
funding is regime-driven: shorts paid 50-75% a year on Bybit in 2024-08 and on Binance in 2025-02..05; a month like that costs a year of carry
reward-token valuation: 31% of rewards are in non-major tokens (largest: a 10M SYND bribe priced at $9.17M that later fell 99%); majors-only valuation cuts the best-venue excess to +8.12%

quotes.note: standby: out of sample (2025-08-28..2026-10-01) the best-venue hedged lock made +11.32% a year over SSR on capital (t 3.81; +8.12% counting major-token rewards only), the pre-committed Binance/Bybit hedge +4.10% (t 1.47); not entered because two legacy epochs remain before the 2026-10-22 merger, the sAERO economics are unmeasured, and a lock sold on Vexy over the last year fetched 15-21% below its AERO (13-19 months of the excess). Re-quote after eight post-merger weeks.
